newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Telecom hits all-time high of 4,600 esc.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Telecom hits all-time high of 4,600 esc.

text.p: Shares of Portugal Telecom hit an all-time high of 4,600 escudos in trade on the Lisbon bourse, dealers said.
PT later rose to 4,611 escudos and dealers said the share would probably move higher.
"There are no sellers in PT and the share will rise further," said one dealer, who gave no specific forecast.
Strong prospects for the telecommunications sector and healthy forecasts for PT's results are stimulating buying of PT shares, dealers said.
Analysts have said they expected PT shares to rise to 5,000 escudos soon, noting that the shares are cheap relative to other telecommunications stocks.
